step_goal: Identifying the performance obligation in a contract
step_description: The process of identifying performance obligation requires an entity to determine whether it promises to transfer either goods or services that are distinct, or a series of distinct goods and services that meet certain conditions. There promises may not be limited to those explicitly included in written contracts.
step_sub_description: Analyzing whether identified promises represent performance obligations:

step_section.section: A. Analyzing whether identified promises represent performance obligations
step_section.section_description:
A. Analyzing whether identified promises represent performance obligations: 
Guidance 
A promise is classified as a performance obligation, if the good or service is capable of being distinct distinct (ASC 606-10-25-19 (a)) and distinct in the context of the contract (ASC 606-10-25-19 (b)). (ASC 606-10-15-14)
